_comment: Merge the kya-wallet entry into your existing claude_desktop_config.json (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json). ABSOLUTE paths are deliberate: Claude Desktop is a GUI app and does NOT have ~/.local/bin on its PATH, so 'npx' would not be found. This form (absolute node + tsx CLI + gateway) needs no PATH. The gateway loads keys+VC from the repo's .env.local (anchored to the repo, not cwd). Fully quit and reopen Claude Desktop after editing. The protected server must be running before you call the tool: npm run serve.
